note: Grok 2026-10-28. Fighting game taught in small parts. Load ONE part when a kid asks. The finished example is the owner's G-Warp Smash remix. Do not paste that whole project at once.

recipes.title: Fighting game part 1: one fighter on the floor
q: load part 1 of a fighting game
make one fighter stand on the floor
start a fight game part one
steps: Make a sprite called Fighter. Paint a simple person. Paint your own person. Do not copy someone else's character.
Green flag: face right only, go to the middle of the floor, and say Ready.
This is only part 1. Next ask for part 2 (walk).

recipes.title: Fighting game part 2: walk left and right
q: load part 2 of the fighting game
add walking to my fight game
steps: Keep part 1. Add this forever loop under the green flag, after go to x y.
Right arrow faces right and steps. Left arrow faces left and steps.
Left-right rotation keeps the picture from flipping upside down.
